_note: `never_fires` lists rules no test has been seen to make fire. Not a target: the list should shrink, and it must not grow without somebody saying why. A rule there is not known to be broken -- it is not known to work. `cannot_fire_by_design` is the separate, closed case.

cannot_fire_by_design.M96.4: a MAY with nothing to violate; the permission is honoured by M96.1 to M96.3 checking the shape when it is used, and by nothing complaining when it is not. Registered so `iirdsv rules` lists the whole catalogue.
